notes.title: Changeling is Out
notes.notes:
I mean, that's fairly obvious at this point but it just feels wrong to not do an anouncement! 

This day has been such a long time in coming that my brain is still catching up with what just happened so I can't think of too much to say! 

We've had a lot of people behind us supporting us, cheering us on, and encouraging us on hard days to this point. Thank you so much to everyone who helped us get here - we are eternally grateful! 


We hope you all enjoy the game. (We posted a partial guide in the guides area of the community to help anyone struggling with the romance endings).


The game has been tested (and tested, and tested and tested) but if you encounter any issues, please let us know! 


Thank you all.


~Esh and Sprocket

notes.title: Release is Coming!
notes.notes:
Finally!

Release is coming up in just a few weeks! Are you hyped for Changeling? Add it to your steam wishlist and stay ready. We are going to be releasing the game very, very soon! We're only waiting on approvals and a few loose ends to be tied up. 

In the meantime, hop over to [url=https://steamberrystudio.tumblr.com/]our blog[/url] where we'll be post lots of fun pre-launch teasers! 

See you all soon!
~Esh
